snippet.title: Elemental: 2D MMORPG Grand Open
snippet.description:
Google Play Store - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ykh.elemental 
Apple Appstore - https://apps.apple.com/app/id6455983161 

Looking for a classic MMORPG experience without loot boxes?

Want a true RPG that makes you feel you're a part of the fight?
Elemental, the pixel art powerhouse of MMORPGs, is the real deal!

Class systems! Gear upgrades! Become the strongest by using the reincarnation system!
A whole new world is waiting for you, adventurer!

Embark on perilous adventures with other players.
Conquer challenging monsters with the help of new friends you meet on your journey.

Pixel art enthusiasts, unite!
Set off on exciting adventures with adorable pixel characters!

Expansive maps and dazzling combo attacks.
Stunning skills in gorgeous pixel art! All in an open-world brimming with lore!

Worried about playing alone? Worry no more! 
Games are better together! Enjoy taking on new challenges together in real time in Elemental!

Unique outfits!
Show off your fashion sense with a huge variety of gear to choose from!

Choose your character!
Every mercenary class has their own unique combat style!

Build a community together!
Find allies, friends, and rivals with our co-op systems! Learn new systems with new friends!
